en: Black‑and‑white historical postcard showing a large crowd gathered in a palace courtyard. In the left foreground several uniformed guards and a child stand near a raised podium draped with a cloth bearing multiple crowns. A figure on the podium addresses a dense line of people standing opposite in the open courtyard, backed by the long façade of a grand Baroque palace with many rectangular windows. Swedish text is printed along the bottom margin of the image.
